Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with evidence for severe insulin resistance or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance must meet all of the following criteria: Suspected severe insulin resistance, or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance, as evidenced by one or more of the following: Hyperinsulinemia (i.e. fasting insulin >30microU/mL) High insulin requirement (> 2 units per kg per day or > 200 units total per day) Phenotypic features suggesting a defect in glucose/lipid metabolism: Acanthosis nigricans Lipodystrophy/abnormal fat distribution Xanthomata Fatty liver Known or suspected mutations of the insulin receptor gene Known or suspected autoantibodies to the insulin receptor Age >= 6 months Ability of subject or Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's data does not provide evidence of hyperinsulinemia, high insulin requirement, or phenotypic features suggesting severe insulin resistance. There is no mention of mutations in the insulin receptor gene or autoantibodies to the insulin receptor. However, the patient is over 6 months old and has provided informed consent, which meets some criteria.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Family members of patients, above --Pregnant at the time of enrollment
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not a family member of another patient; he is the subject himself.

Recap: The patient does not meet the inclusion criteria for severe insulin resistance or associated disorders due to lack of specific evidence such as hyperinsulinemia or phenotypic features. The exclusion criterion regarding pregnancy is irrelevant to this patient.
